qualifications: The original 三合 chapter requires allthree actual characters for 三合化局; this is not a sufficient transformation test.
The 三刑 chapter gives directed edges, repeat conditions and both 无恩/恃势 naming systems, explicitly quoting 三车一览.
The scan115 passage itself prints 申子申 in one water-bureau sentence, while its opening and birth/peak/storage context identify 申子辰; raw text retained, no silent input regrading.
The chapter does not itself supply the project all8 half-pair table or calibrated score weights.
